column3: “Covenant loyalty of your youth” is rendered “the devotion of your youth.”
“The land of the orchard” is rendered “the fruitful land.”
“Are burnt” (Qere) is rendered “have been destroyed,” following the written text.
“They will graze your scalp” is rendered “Have shaved the crown of your head.”
“Shihor” is rendered “the Nile,” and “the River” as “the Euphrates.”
“I will not transgress” (Ketiv) is rendered “I will not serve,” following the Qere.
“Wood” is rendered “a tree,” and “gave birth to us” as “gave me birth.”
